text:
emma-marketing: Quick kickoff for Orbit Convergence next month. Plan: 20m stage demo (live inference + visualized latency), booth mini-webinar the following week, and a lead routing flow that distinguishes enterprise interest. Goals = capture qualified demos + webinar RSVPs.

jake-sales: Agree. Need an explicit qualification flow so sales only chases high-intent leads. Suggested fields: company, role, use-case, budget timeframe, demo_interest.

sofia-design: For stage: 1 intro slide, then switch to live UI running streaming output (auto-scroll). I can make a looping 6s social GIF showing our latency numbers for promos. Also mock two card layouts: "standard" (QR + short link) and "collector" (card + scratch code).

matt-logistics: For physicals: vendor lead times: cards 5 business days, stickers 3, enamel pins 7. If we want pins for scarcity, need to order today. Shipping cost for rush pins = +$220.

emma-marketing: Budget ok for limited pins. Idea: give pins only after qualifying call booked (enterprise only). Cards = 300, stickers = 500, pins = 75.

oliver-ops: Routing: QR -> short landing with form. I'll spin up an Airtable base and a Zapier webhook. Fields: email, company, role, contact_tier (radio), demo_interest (yes/no), event_code. Then automation to populate view "orbit-enterprise": filter contact_tier=enterprise AND demo_interest=yes. Push to #sales-inbound with lead row link.

lex-customer-events: For the webinar tie-in we should capture the session timezone and provide an on-demand replay link on the card back in case the attendee wants it later. Also add copy "see short benchmark summary on back".

jake-sales: For qualification rubric: enterprise = company size >500 OR procurement detail present. Demo_interest = willing to schedule 30-60 day follow-up. I'll write short scripts for booth to confirm.

sofia-design: Card copy front: "Predictable LLM inference at scale" + large QR. Back: 3 bullets: latency drop, cost per 1k tokens, one customer quote. Tiny secondary QR -> replay. I'll attach mock by Thursday.

matt-logistics: Staffing: need 3 booth reps per shift (AM/PM). Can we do Tue-Fri? Shipping address for materials is Event Hall B. Need contact at venue for dropoff; I'm confirming. Also confirm printer proofs: I want a digital proof before we print.

emma-marketing: Social plan: 3 posts: pre-event teaser (gif), day-of live clip, post-event webinar invite. Use UTM campaign orbit-conv-2026. Sofia to produce assets, I'll schedule.

oliver-ops: Example webhook payload (will be sent as JSON in the webhook body):

```
{
  "email": "name@example.com",
  "company": "Acme Inc.",
  "role": "Engineering Manager",
  "contact_tier": "enterprise",
  "demo_interest": true,
  "event_code": "ORBIT-26"
}
```

sofia-design: Also recommend we print a quick single-sheet cheat for booth reps with: 30s elevator, 90s demo script, 3 qualifier questions, and handoff flow. Jake can author the script.

jake-sales: Will draft the cheat and a 3-question qualification set: 1) What are you building? 2) How important is latency/cost for you? 3) Are you evaluating vendors in the next 90 days? If enterprise=yes & timeframe <=90d -> tag as priority.

lex-customer-events: Webinar cadence: one week after event, 45-minute deep dive, Q&A. Follow-up email includes 1-page benchmark narrative + link to book one-on-one. Use HubSpot for registration/flow.

matt-logistics: I'll place order once Sofia confirms card art. Pins: can be handed out by sales rep after qualification, not at check-in. We'll have a sign: "Pins reserved for qualified conversations."

emma-marketing: Action items: Sofia mock card + social gif by Thu, Oliver Airtable + webhook by Wed, Matt vendor confirmation + shipping by Wed, Jake sales cheat + qualification script by Tue, Lex to configure webinar registration flow by Fri. I'll assemble post-event landing copy and draft email.

oliver-ops: I'll also add a fallback: static demo recording hosted on S3 and the card secondary QR points there if the kiosk network fails.

sofia-design: One more ask: can we get brand-approved photo of the booth backdrop/logo from ops? Need it for mockups.

matt-logistics: Yep, sending the high-res logo and dimensions to you in 30m.

marketing-bot: Reminder: swag request form deadline in 48 hours https://intranet/requests/swag

emma-marketing: Cool. If everyone can confirm their deliverables in this thread I'll lock the checklist and post the rehearsal time. Rehearsal likely next Monday 10AM. :rocket:
